clarified_intent.description: Independently audit the Flutter provenance implementation and archive evidence without overclaiming Dart runtime or full-release readiness.

constraints: Every plan acceptance claim must have direct repository-contained evidence.
One canonical Dart owner and the non-buildable provenance boundary must remain intact.
Unapproved source, missing mappings, license drift, duplicate ownership, and publication authority must fail closed.
Visual evidence must prove lineage without fabricating Flutter UI or accessibility evidence.
All runtime, platform, legal, security, certification, and publication limits must remain explicit.

target_state.description: A reproducible archive bundle with zero unsupported runtime, platform, certification, or publication claims.
success_criteria: All provenance tests and BDD pass
Git history, mappings, licenses, and canonical ownership verify
Evidence JSON parses and every referenced path exists
Coverage, skills, package, documentation, and release ledgers agree
Visual boundary is hash-bound and independently inspected
